Introduction

E Omong, also written as EOMONG and Lee Omong, is a South Korean virtual entertainer, BJ, and singer under MEECHU. She made her debut as a singer on September 12, 2023 with the digital single "The Owl". In 2025, she became a member of the virtual girl group TSSJ.
